description: An open model picker closes when a turn starts. The screen is 1280x800. Call "mark settings" remembers how many requests to a /settings URL the page has sent; call "settings since mark" returns how many it has sent since. Call "start turn" sends the conversation the message "bash: sleep 8" through the API (not through the page), starting a turn that runs for 8 seconds. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. data-testid "message-input" should be visible (allow 30s). 3. Click ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label": ".model-picker-panel" should be visible. 4. Call "mark settings". 5. Call "start turn". 6. data-testid "agent-thinking" should be visible (allow 20s). 7. There should be no ".model-picker-panel" (count 0). 8. Call "settings since mark": it must return "0".
